grammar:
%rule text (Q $x:choice) %conditions ¬($x.without-elision.matches(choice))

%rule choice ((a & b) (c ≻ d))
%rule a X %conditions ¬($.starts-input)

%rule b X %conditions $.starts-input

%rule c (Y [+T])
%rule d (Y [+U])
description: A seal entry distinguishes the earlier public control route (engine §4 and §10).
